title: Causal Structures in Neural Networks
description: Exploring how causal frameworks can enhance our understanding of neural network decision-making, combining Pearl's do-calculus with modern interpretability techniques.

title: Type Theory and Knowledge Representation
description: Investigating how Martin-Löf type theory and category theory can provide formal foundations for representing knowledge in AI systems.

title: Beyond Statistical Learning: Embedding Semantic Structures
description: Examining how geometric embedding techniques can incorporate semantic and causal information, moving beyond pure statistical correlations.

title: Formal Methods in Machine Learning Interpretability
description: A rigorous approach to understanding neural network behavior through the lens of formal mathematical methods and categorical structures.
